rules.name: Transport
rules.description: This model can transport 12 Infantry & 6 Drone models within it.

rules.description: Instead of Setting to Overwatch, this unit may set to Bastion Run. When a unit sets to Bastion Run it gains and +1 to its Front Armour (FA), Side Armour (SA) and Rear Armour (RA) characteristics until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: High Kâhl
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade gains +1 to its Weapon Skill (WS), Wounds, (W), Attacks (A) and Leadership (LD) characteristics. In addition, when using the Appraising Glare Reaction, you may select 2 enemy units to gain a Grudge Token. The unit further gains the Battle-Hardened special rule.

rules.name: Mass Driver System
rules.description: A model with this wargear has the Fleet and Hammer of Wrath (3) special rules.

rules.name: Multi-Spectral Vizor (Reaction)
rules.description: Instead of Setting to Overwatch, this unit may set to Scanning Sweep. When this unit sets to do a Scanning Sweep, you may select a single friendly Leagues of Votann unit within 6”. That unit gains +1 to its Ballistic Skill (BS) Characteristic until the end of the phase. A unit may set to this Reaction even if it has the Slow & Purposeful special rule.

rules.name: Thrice Slain
rules.description: If this unit is your Warlord, it has the Feel no Pain (4+) special rule and may re-roll Regeneration Rolls.

rules.name: The Waaghbreaker
rules.description: If this unit is your Warlord, all Orks in your opponents army count as having a Grudge Token. In addition, this unit and any Cthonian Beserk unit it is attached to gain +1 to their Attacks (A) characteristic when using the Rage special rule.

rules.name: The Destined
rules.description: If this unit is your Warlord, when this unit would be slain and removed from play, do not. Instead, it remains on the battlefield with D3 wound remaining.

rules.name: Preymark Crest
rules.description: A unit with this wargear must select a single enemy unit during Deployment, this unit gains the Preferred Enemy special rule when targeting the selected unit.

rules.name: H.E Mine
rules.description: Instead of setting to Overwatch, a unit that includes a model with this wargear may Set to Plant Mines. When a unit Sets to Plant Mines, place a Mine marker within 3” of this unit at the end of the Shooting phase. Any enemy unit that ends its Movement Phase within 6” of a Mine Marker takes D6+1, Strength 4, AP5 Automatic hits. Wounds and saves are made as normal.

rules.name: For Science!
rules.description: During deployment, select a single unit type in the game to field test this units weapon against. This unit gains the Bane (x) special rule where x is the chosen type.

rules.name: Master of Strategy
rules.description:
During Deployment, select one of the following effects for this unit and any attached unit to gain:
• The units gain the Outflank special rule.
• The units gain the Tank Hunter special rule.
• The units gain the Scout special rule.
• The units gain the Monster Hunter special rule.
• The units gain the Skirmisher special rule.

sharedRules.name: Eye of the Ancestors
sharedRules.description: Each time a Votann unit with this special rule would be destroyed and its last model remaining removed from play from being slain or wrecked, the enemy unit that inflicted the last wound or penetrating hit allocated to that unit has a Grudge Token placed on it. Any attached unit with the Character special rule retains the Grudge Token should its attached unit be slain. If a unit with the Character special rule join a new unit during the battle, the entire unit is conferred a Grudge token. Votann units gain the Hatred special rule when targeting a unit with a Grudge token as part of an attack in the Shooting or Combat Phase.

sharedRules.name: Hero of the Oathband
sharedRules.description: You may only include 1 model in your army with this special rule.

sharedRules.name: E-Cog
sharedRules.description: Units or models with this special rule may always join Votann Infantry units even though they do not have the Infantry type.

sharedRules.name: Grim & Methodical
sharedRules.description: Greater Thurian units in your army have the Slow & Purposeful special rule.

sharedRules.name: Ruthless Efficiency
sharedRules.description: Greater Thurian units always count as controlling an objective regardless of how many models are contesting the objective.

sharedRules.name: Nomad Warriors
sharedRules.description: Trans-Hyperian units must re-roll all successful Pinning and Panic tests.

sharedRules.name: Cult of Veneration
sharedRules.description: All Trans-Hyperian units gain the Zealot special rule.

sharedRules.name: Bloody Expectation
sharedRules.description: Kronus Hegemony units must attempt to charge in the Charge Phase if there are any eligible units in Charge range.

sharedRules.name: Violent Disposition
sharedRules.description: Kronus Hegemony units gain the Furious Charge special rules.

sharedRules.name: Cost Benefit Ratio
sharedRules.description: YMYR Conglomerate Hearthkyn Warrior units gain the Expendable special rule.

sharedRules.name: Wealth is Power
sharedRules.description: A YMYR Conglomerate units gain the Night Vision special rule.

sharedRules.name: Dour Survivalists
sharedRules.description: All URSR units gain the Feel no Pain (6+) special rule.

sharedRules.name: Inflexible determination
sharedRules.description: URSR units in your army may not perform Retreat Moves in the Movement Phase. In addition, when a URSR unit would lose combat and Panic, it does not perform a move and instead simply remains in locked in combat.

sharedRules.name: Appraising Glare (Reaction)
sharedRules.description: Instead of Setting to Overwatch, this unit may set to appraise. When this unit sets to Appraise, place 1 Grudge Token on an enemy unit that is visible to this unit. A unit may set to this Reaction even if it has the Slow & Purposeful special rule.

rules.name: Trike
rules.description: A model that is equipped with a Trike becomes the Bike type. In addition, the model gains +1 to its Toughness (T) characteristic. A Trike is equipped with a Heavy Stubber.

rules.name: Weavefield Crest
rules.description: A model with an Weavefield Crest has a 5+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Rampart Crest
rules.description: A model with a Rampart Crest and any attached unit has a 5+ Invulnerable save against Shooting attacks.

rules.name: Teleport Crest
rules.description: A model with a Teleport Crest gains the Deep Strike special rule.

rules.name: Ancestral Ward Crest
rules.description: A model with an Ancestral Ward Crest has a 4+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: HunTR Module
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear gains the Linked special rule on all Ranged weapons they are equipped with when targeting an enemy unit with a Grudge Token.

rules.name: Omni-Vizors
rules.description: A model with this wargear gains the Night Vision special rule.

rules.name: Multiweave Comms Array
rules.description: A model with this Wargear and their unit automatically Rally at the start of the Movement Phase.

rules.name: Pan Spectral Scanner
rules.description: Enemy units may not arrive from reserves within 12” of a model equipped with this wargear.

rules.name: Void Hardened Armour
rules.description: Basic Combat armour for void combat. It provides a 4+ Armour Save.

rules.name: Artifice Void Hardened Armour
rules.description: Master Crafted Combat armour for void combat. It provides a 3+ Armour Save.

rules.name: Void Plate
rules.description: Lighter armour plate. This confers a 5+ Armour save.

rules.name: Ironkin Cladding
rules.description: The Heavy plating of Ironkin provides excellent protection. It confers a 3+ Armour save.

rules.name: Exo-Armour
rules.description: Super Heavy Combat armour used by the Votann. It provides a 2+ Armour save. The equipped model gains the Bulky (2) & Relentless special rule. The equipped model gains +1 to its Strength (S), Toughness (T) characteristics.

rules.name: Exo-Frame
rules.description: A large reinforced powered frame. This confers a 3+ Armour save. A model equipped with this wargear gains the Bulky (3), Relentless and Slow & Purposeful special rules. A model with this wargear gains +1 to its Toughness (T) and Wounds (W) characteristic.

rules.name: A Long List
rules.description: Once per phase, while your warlord is alive and on the battlefield, when a unit with a Grudge Token is destroyed and removed from play, you move their Grudge Token to another enemy unit on the battlefield within 12” of the destroyed units last remaining model before it was removed from play, slain or wrecked.

rules.name: Guild Connections
rules.description: A model with this Warlord Trait gains the Master-Crafted special rule on all Weapons they are equipped with.

rules.name: Unrelenting Toil
rules.description: A unit with this Warlord trait and any attached unit automatically pass Pinning Tests and Panic tests.

rules.description: Enemy units within 3” of a model equipped with this Relic are treated as Initiative (I) 1.

rules.name: The Grey Crest
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic and any attached unit may only be targeted for Shooting Attacks in the Shooting Phase if they are the closest visible enemy unit.

rules.name: Null Vortex
rules.description: When this power is cast, select a single enemy unit within 12” of the Psyker. That unit may not make Invulnerable saves until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Fortify
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain +1 to their Toughness (T) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Crushing Contempt
rules.description: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 24” of the Psyker. That target unit may not make any Movement actions in its next Movement Phase and may not declare Charges in its next Charge Phase.

rules.name: Grudgepyre
rules.description: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 18” of the Psyker. That target unit takes D6, Strength 3, AP- Automatic Hits. If the target has a Grudge Token on it, it instead takes 2D6, Strength 5, AP4 Automatic Hits.

rules.name: Self Destruct
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, select a Vehicle, Automata, Walker or Aircraft unit within 3” of the unit performing this Rite or a unit they embarked upon. The target unit immediately Explodes per the Vehicle Damage Chart.

rules.name: Repair Procedures
rules.description:
When this Rite is performed successfully, select one of the following effects:
• Select 1 Walker or Automata unit either within 3” or attached to the unit that is performing this rite. The target unit Heals 1 wound.
• Select 1 Vehicle, Aircraft, Knight or Fortification either within 3”, attached to the unit performing this Rite or that this unit is embarked upon. Select 1 weapon that target unit is equipped with that has been destroyed. The chosen weapon is no longer destroyed.
• Select 1 Vehicle or Knight either within 3”, attached to the unit performing this Rite or that this unit is embarked upon that is immobilized. That unit is no longer immobilized. If the unit has the Super Heavy (x) special rule and was Limping, it is no longer considered to be Limping.

rules.name: Galvanic Overcharge
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, select a Vehicle, Automata, Walker or Aircraft unit within 3” of the unit performing this Rite or a unit they embarked upon may immediately make a Normal Move. However, the selected unit may not Shoot in the Shooting Phase or Charge in the Charge Phase.

rules.name: Target Lock
rules.description: When this Rite is performed successfully, select a Vehicle, Automata, Walker or Aircraft unit within 3” of the unit performing this Rite or a unit they embarked upon. The unit gains +1 Attack with 1 Shooting weapon it is equipped with until the start of you next Shooting Phase.
